{{Top|leg}}
A '''gravity disk''' or '''gravitational disk''' was a device found in the decks of [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] designed to maintain [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].

==History==
While replacing the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] disks in the deck plates of a docked [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] at [[Pellezara station]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the seventeen-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] discovered a wounded woman&mdash;[[Jan Ors]]&mdash;in a secret compartment. He learned that the freighter carried stolen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cargo destined for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He helped Ors and her [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to reach safety, and joined the Rebellion soon thereafter.
